Provides access to Devil's Thumb Trail, Fourth of July Road, Lost Lakes, and more.

properties.creator: RUJB43
properties.description: Trails near the town of Nederland. Requires recent snowfall. Also know as West Mag.
properties.title: West Magnolia

properties.creator: RUJB43
properties.description:
Popular spot for nordic skiing on the front range, with many people coming each weekend. Parking is at the Brainard Lake Winter Parking Area. Brainard Lake Road is closed from this point onward in the winter. Good connection to neighboring areas via Sourdough Trail.
Due to high elevation relative to other front range options, holds snow well after season starts (and typically sees the earliest snow).
properties.title: Brainard Lake

properties.creator: RUJB43
properties.description: Area accessible from the town of Eldora. Main trails from the trailhead are Devil's Thumb Trial and Fourth of July Road. More expansive options available, but require 10+ mile round trips. Be cautious of increasing avalanche risk as evelation increase begins quickly after a certain point.
properties.title: Hessie/Lost Lake

properties.creator: RUJB43
properties.description:
Groomed by Boulder Nordic Club!
Roughly 1k loop groomed in the winter for skate whenever conditions allow.
Grooming info available at: https://bouldernordic.org/trail-conditions/
Favorite us on Nordic Pulse: https://nordic-pulse.com/ski-areas/US/CO/Boulder-Nordic-Club
properties.title: North Boulder Park

properties.creator: RUJB43
properties.description: Mellow area easily accessible off the Peak-to-Peak Highway. Requires recent snowfall to be skiable. Watch out for rocks!
properties.title: Caribou Ranch

properties.creator: RUJB43
properties.description: Southern area in Rocky Mountain National Park. Lower elevation areas require recent snowfall, and elevant increases quickly once closer to the mountains (pay attention to avalanche risk and run-out areas if traveling near high-angle terrain).
properties.title: Wild Basin (RMNP)

properties.creator: RUJB43
properties.description:
Area with a long winding road to ski on or steeper trails. Ability to cross the Continental Divide via Rollins Pass Road. Top will frequently be wind swept, requiring hiking to cross over the ridge. 
Holds snow through the season well.
Be cautious of avalanche risk when nearing the mountains.
properties.title: Moffat Tunnel / Rollins Pass

properties.creator: RUJB43
properties.description: Winding trail starting at the road for Rainbow Lakes, progressing up through Brainard briefly, and ending in the Peaceful Valley area. Requires recent snowfall for good coverage.
properties.title: Sourdough Trail

properties.creator: RUJB43
properties.description: Peaceful Vallye and Beaver Reservoir area. Will largely require recent snow to be skiable. Provides access to Buchannan Pass. Connected to Sourdough trail.
properties.title: Peaceful Valley
